name: Nano Banana Pro Generate
description: Generate an image from a text prompt using Nano Banana Pro (Google Gemini 3 Pro Image). Same model offered via 3 gateways: StableStudio (async, cheapest, default), Xona (synchronous, returns image URL inline), and Orthogonal (native Google Gemini generateContent passthrough). Supports 1K/2K/4K output and multiple aspect ratios.

usage.callShape: ASYNC on default (StableStudio): POST JSON {prompt} -> {jobId,status:'pending'}; poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX, free) ~20-25s until status=='complete' -> result.imageUrl. Xona is SYNC (returns image_url inline). Orthogonal is SYNC native-Gemini (contents/parts in, base64 inlineData out).

inputExample.prompt: a red circle on white background

usage.outputShape: StableStudio POST: success(bool), jobId(string), status('pending'), type('nano-banana-pro-generate'). Poll GET: id, type, input{model,prompt,imageSize,aspectRatio}, status('complete'), progress(100), result.imageUrl(hosted PNG on *.public.blob.vercel-storage.com), error, createdAt, updatedAt. | Xona: image_url, image_description, metadata. | Orthogonal: Gemini candidates[].content.parts[].inlineData.data (base64).
quirks: MULTI-GATEWAY but NOT drop-in interchangeable: each gateway has a DIFFERENT request/response shape. StableStudio & Xona use simple {prompt}; Orthogonal uses native Google Gemini {contents:[{parts:[{text}]}]}.

StableStudio (default) is ASYNC: the paid POST does NOT return the image, only {jobId,status:'pending'}. You MUST poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} until status=='complete' (~24s observed). Image at result.imageUrl (hosted PNG, NOT base64).

The poll endpoint /api/jobs/{jobId} is SIWX-gated (free): returns 403/Unauthorized to a DIFFERENT wallet identity. You must poll with the SAME wallet that paid the POST. (MCP agentcash fetch failed with 403 because its identity differs from the qa-pay/Sponge wallet that created the job.)
StableStudio field names: aspectRatio (camelCase) + imageSize ('1K'/'2K'/'4K'). Xona uses aspect_ratio (snake_case) + referenceImage[]. Do NOT mix the two field conventions.
Xona is SYNCHRONOUS — returns body.image_url directly, no polling needed. Cheaper to integrate but $0.02 more per call.

Orthogonal returns base64 inline image data (Gemini inlineData), not a hosted URL; add generationConfig.responseModalities:['IMAGE'] to force image output and tools:[{googleSearch:{}}] for grounded/factual images.
Payment settles on Base (USDC). StableStudio price observed exactly $0.13.

description: Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash Image — pro-quality at Flash speed: text-to-image, editing, multi-image composition (up to 5 characters / 14 objects), subject consistency, precise text rendering.

name: Stableflare Image Generation
description: Run any official Replicate image model (generation, editing, upscaling) via a single async x402 endpoint: pay the create POST, then poll the free status endpoint for the hosted output image.

model.description: Official Replicate model id as owner/name, e.g. 'black-forest-labs/flux-schnell'.

Then poll POST https://stableflare.dev/api/replicate/predictions/get {id} (free, SIWX auth) every ~30s until status=='succeeded' -> output (array; image URL at output[0]).

usage.outputShape: Create POST returns {id, status:'starting', model, urls:{get,cancel}}. Poll returns {id, status, model, output, error, metrics, urls}. For image models, output is an ARRAY of hosted image URLs (e.g. https://replicate.delivery/.../out-0.webp); read output[0].

It is NOT restricted to the paying wallet — verified by polling with a different (agentcash) signed-in wallet than the one that paid. Any valid SIWX identity can read the prediction.
output shape is MODEL-DEPENDENT: image models return a string array of URLs (output[0]); other models may return an object or single string. resultPath 'output.0' matches image models.

Failures are NOT refunded: payment settles on the create POST. Call the free/SIWX discovery endpoints (/api/replicate/models/get) and validate input against the model's latest_version.openapi_schema before submitting, especially for costlier create-* siblings.
The 'model' field must be an OFFICIAL Replicate model id (owner/name); the caller supplies both the model and its input envelope. This single endpoint fronts many models — it is not a fixed model.
openapi advertises an MPP (Tempo) protocol alongside x402; only the x402 (Base USDC) accept is indexed here (MPP excluded per registry policy). Payment observed exactly $0.10 on Base.
